opening.argument: The recording is presented as a talk show focused on dengue symptoms, prevention, and home-care guidance. It introduces dengue as the subject, explains how to recognize it, advises viewers to limit mosquitoes around the home, and directs those who do not improve to consult a doctor. The reference to papaya leaves appears in a patient-care discussion, not as a promoted transaction or guaranteed remedy. Although viewers are asked to subscribe to Byan TV channels, that is ordinary audience engagement. The record shows no payment request, investment opportunity, request for private information, supported link, or other participation mechanism connected to financial harm.
